Game Overview

Ricochet Arrow puts players into a zombie experience centered on become a fearless archer in Ricochet Arrow, where every shot counts as you navigate through 50 tactical levels. Master the art of bouncing arrows off surfaces, destroy menacing skeletons, and outsmart friends in thrilling PvP skirmishes. Precision and strategy are your best allies in this high-stakes adventure.
